source_caption:
At the end of Jojo Rabbit, the final scene features the song “Heroes” by David Bowie playing in German. Director Taika Waititi chose it because the film repeatedly references Bowie’s music, and he wanted the ending to feel like a moment of liberation and hope after everything the characters had endured.

Jojo Rabbit (2019), directed by Taika Waititi, starring Roman Griffin Davis, Thomasin McKenzie, Scarlett Johansson. A daring and heartfelt satire that follows a young boy in Nazi Germany whose world begins to change when he discovers the truth beyond the propaganda he has grown up with.

source_details.synopsis: Jojo Rabbit is a 2019 satirical comedy-drama film written and directed by Taika Waititi, adapted from Christine Leunens' 2008 book Caging Skies. Roman Griffin Davis makes his film debut as the title character, Johannes "Jojo" Betzler, a ten-year-old Hitler Youth member who finds out that his mother (Scarlett Johansson) is hiding a Jewish girl (Thomasin McKenzie) in their attic. He must then question his beliefs while dealing with the intervention of his imaginary friend, a childlike, eccentric version of Adolf Hitler (played by Waititi) with a comedic stance on the politics of the war. The film also stars Sam Rockwell, Rebel Wilson, Stephen Merchant, and Alfie Allen. Waititi wrote the screen
